text.tspan: 'The build should fail loudly for exactly the thing you'd otherwise ship silently.'
'Reproduce, minimise, hypothesise — in that order, every time.'
'Fix the cause, not the ceiling — raising the limit is how debt collects interest.'
'MCP servers: typed access to my own tools'
'Prototyping relentlessly — five throwaway spikes a week'
'Agentic coding — Claude as a build system, not autocomplete'
'Context engineering: what to load, summarise, and drop'
